author: Ting Wang (Tzu-Ting), with Sam Illingworth
basis: First-person career account plus proposed AI inquiry
reported_outcomes: Wang reports that naming the cost of returning reduced felt pressure during a career choice; the account does not isolate AI’s contribution.
proposed_outcomes: Make practical reversibility and constraints explicit.
limits: Visa, tax, pension and employment facts need authoritative checking; none is established by the prompt.
AI must not reclassify a structural constraint as merely emotional.
A return route can change after the decision.
review_note: Retain as an inquiry checklist, not career, tax or legal advice.
coverage: Close-read all 98 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
